d: The US-Iran conflict is heating up again. Tehran claims it has struck American military targets in Kuwait and Bahrain, while US fighter jets have hit an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island, near the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. Washington is also increasing its military presence, with a third aircraft carrier group entering the region. But what happened to diplomacy? With Donald Trump facing pressure at home, Iran believes it has room to push for more concessions. Tehran wants sanctions lifted, access to frozen funds, and a say in how shipping resumes through the Strait of…
